selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including bilateral blurred vision and ocular irritation, along with the presence of Chikungunya virus in the aqueous tap PCR results and positive IgM CHIKV serologic test, support this diagnosis. The absence of trauma and previous inflammation in the ocular history and the specific findings of stromal immune ring formation and keratic precipitates also align with this condition.

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: Lack of heterochromia and specific findings not mentioned

rejected.label: Immune-mediated keratitis
rejected.why: Not as specific to the patient's presentation as Chikungunya virus-associated uveitis

rejected.label: Stromal keratitis
rejected.why: Too general and does not account for the full spectrum of the patient's symptoms and test results
